module_summary: Lemmings Moore FSM with async reset: walks left/right, reverses on bumps, falls when ground disappears and resumes prior direction.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: WL/WR/FALLL/FALLR register; remembers direction through falls and decodes all outputs.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from WL state.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from WR state.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Falling indicator decoded from either fall state.

anchors.name: ground
anchors.why: Ground presence; overrides bumps, enters or leaves fall states.

anchors.name: bump_left
anchors.why: Left obstacle; flips WL to WR.

anchors.name: bump_right
anchors.why: Right obstacle; flips WR to WL.

groups.name: lemming_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic, async-reset state register and Moore output decode.
